gen-gf-offside-gf-anek-devanagari: Anek Devanagari has tall, openly shaped letters that make a plain sans feel generous and easy to settle into. Anek Devanagari carries a text this way for pages on end, while Offside's widely spaced, ribbon-flat strokes stay level above it.
gen-gf-offside-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Offside draws every curve at a single width, refusing to close its rounds and spacing its letters wide. And Anek Gurmukhi, with big open counters in its small letters, feels more relaxed and open-handed beside that stiff display voice.
gen-gf-offside-gf-anek-kannada: Anek Kannada reads tall and squared-off, with terminals stopping well clear of the stem. Offside sits above it as a widely spaced, paperclip-bent line, and the two feel like one steady hand.
gen-gf-offside-gf-anek-latin: Rope-like strokes that never swell or thin, curves left unclosed, and wide tracking mark Offside at once. Anek Latin follows with lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals, its letters held open rather than curled shut.
gen-gf-offside-gf-anek-malayalam: Anek Malayalam reads close and tidy, with little gap between x-height and caps and curve tips that never touch. Offside, ruler-straight and widely spaced, leads above it.
gen-gf-offside-gf-anek-odia: Offside has one stroke weight from start to finish, curves that never close, and wide tracking. Anek Odia keeps its rounds unlatched like an open hook, so shrinking the heading would leave the two nearly matched.
gen-gf-offside-gf-anek-tamil: Offside's flat, unswelling line runs along every curve, leaving rounds unclosed and letters widely spaced. And Anek Tamil does the opposite job well, with big round lowercase bowls and half-unwrapped c and s shapes made for steady reading.
gen-gf-offside-gf-anek-telugu: Wire-bent s curves that never thin at the spine give Offside its commanding, widely tracked look. Anek Telugu does the quieter work, its wide, tall bowls and unlatched rounds setting a friendly reading rhythm.
gen-gf-offside-gf-anuphan: Anuphan brings big round lowercase bowls and open curves with clear gaps, a sans that feels clean and unfussy. Offside's smooth drawn-wire heading is what makes the pair work.
gen-gf-offside-gf-arimo: Offside heads the pair with zero stroke contrast, unclosed curves and wide tracking, all in a level, commanding voice. But Arimo's tall mean line and spacious terminal gaps give the pair its strongest quality, a sturdy, readable body.
